## Change type

- [ ] Factual correction
- [ ] Evidence-boundary correction
- [ ] Documentation clarification
- [ ] Public-example or schema correction
- [ ] Other

## Required record

- Exact files changed:
- Reason for change:
- Supporting source or reproducible counterexample:
- Effect on evidence class or public claim boundary:
- Effect on partner attribution or brand wording:
- Repository verifier result:

## Declaration

- [ ] No credentials, private correspondence, customer data, proprietary prompts, or confidential implementation details are included.
- [ ] The change does not silently upgrade internal evidence to independent or production evidence.
